description: Under the transfer shed's roof: a wet concrete apron running to the water's edge, a hand-crank crane, nets drying on hooks. The Basin slaps at the pilings below the loading lip.

window.description: A window set too high in the wall to see the ground through, so it offers the sky and nothing else. On a bad day that is more information than you want.
window.name: the high window

name: The Wet Handoff
